limitations: Three lock/API generations use distinct source/policy/preparation identities. Rates are never pooled between them.
One two-second round per selected coordinate gives no repeat variance estimate or universal performance gain.
Host policy is fixed at 2 GHz with sampled telemetry; exact effective frequency at every instruction is not established.
Successful local NO_JIT is not returned-JIT execution; all table classifications remain unchanged.
The shared-MM comparison uses a separate enabled kernel and local lock adapter; no MM-body delegation is claimed.
Old partial attempts and failed unscored controls remain failed and outside canonical counts.
This index rechecks retained audit/plan/table/receipt bindings; it does not rerun guest tests or repeat every per-workload oracle.
scope: Coverage index across distinct frozen generations, not one pooled performance campaign.
